name: python-sieve
title: Sieve Minimum Spanning Tree
blurb: sieve of Eratosthenes up to small n: the prime list equals the shipped oracle (trial division) on every seeded n, each prime crosses off its multiples starting at its square, and is_prime agrees; non-positive or oversized n is named, never sieved.
default_description: A spanning-tree walker whose total is the enumeration oracle's minimum on every small undirected graph, whose witness ledger tells the truth, and whose tree spans every node exactly once.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: each prime crosses off its multiples starting at its square
